Eid Al Etihad guide · 2026

How to plan a National Day office celebration

By the Messify team · Updated November 2026 · 4 min read

Quick answer

Hold your office National Day celebration on one of the last working days before Eid Al Etihad (2 and 3 December 2026). The simplest formats are a lunch buffet or a majlis-style coffee morning: Arabic coffee and dates on arrival, an Emirati-inspired rice dish such as machboos at the centre, grills, salads and a vegetarian main, and luqaimat to finish. Fix the headcount early and book catering at least a day ahead.

Planning an event? Send your date, emirate and headcount and we'll come back with a menu and a price.

When to hold it

Eid Al Etihad, UAE National Day, is a public holiday on Wednesday 2 and Thursday 3 December 2026. Most offices celebrate on one of the last working days before it, between late November and 1 December. Pick the day early: those dates are also the start of year-end party season, so caterers and venues fill up. If you're celebrating with family or the community, lunches and dinners on 2 and 3 December are the most popular.

Pick a format

  • A lunch buffet at the office: the easiest to organise and the most inclusive, because everyone is already there. Allow 45 to 60 minutes.
  • A majlis-style morning: Arabic coffee, dates, sweets and karak tea in a seating area dressed for the day. Lighter, and easy to fit around meetings.
  • An afternoon celebration: savoury bites, sweets and drinks after a short programme, such as a talk on the UAE's history or a team photo.

Menu ideas

A National Day spread usually starts with Arabic coffee and dates as guests arrive. At the centre is a generous rice dish such as machboos, with grills, salads and mezze around it. Finish with luqaimat and other Arabic sweets. For an international team, mix in a dish or two from other cuisines, and always include a vegetarian main. Keep everything halal so everyone can eat everything.

  • Welcome: Arabic coffee, dates, savoury bites and sambousek
  • Mains: machboos or mandi, grilled chicken or lamb, a vegetarian main, salads and mezze, bread
  • To finish: luqaimat, Arabic sweets, fruit, karak tea and juices

How much food to order

For a lunch buffet, plan per guest about 150 g of rice, 175 g of meat or chicken, 100 g of vegetable dishes, a portion of salad, 1 to 2 pieces of bread and a dessert. For a coffee morning or afternoon gathering, plan 6 to 8 savoury bites, 3 or 4 sweets or dates and 2 drinks per guest. Our food per person guide has a calculator for your headcount.

Touches people remember

  • A traditional dress day, with kandura and abaya welcome for everyone who wants to join.
  • Decor in the flag's red, green, white and black, or Al Sadu weave patterns on table runners.
  • An Arabic coffee corner, served the traditional way.
  • A photo wall and a group photo for the company's channels.

A booking timeline

  • As soon as you can: fix the date, a rough headcount and the format, and ask for a catering quote.
  • 3 to 5 days before: confirm the menu, the serving time and building access (delivery pass, service lift, loading bay).
  • 2 days before: confirm the final headcount and any dietary needs.
  • The day before: the last day to place an order with us. We don't take same-day orders.

Questions people ask

What food is served on UAE National Day?

Emirati dishes such as machboos, harees, luqaimat and balaleet, with Arabic coffee and dates. Offices with international teams often mix in dishes from other cuisines.

When should an office celebrate National Day?

On one of the last working days before Eid Al Etihad. In 2026 the holiday is on 2 and 3 December, so most offices celebrate between late November and 1 December.

How much food do we need for a National Day lunch?

Per guest, about 150 g of rice, 175 g of meat or chicken, 100 g of vegetable dishes, a salad, bread and a dessert.

What are easy National Day ideas for the office?

A traditional dress day, decor in the flag colours, an Arabic coffee corner, a photo wall and a shared lunch.

How late can we book National Day catering with Messify?

We need at least one day's notice and do not take same-day orders. The days just before the holiday fill first, so enquire as early as you can.
